author: Victor Galvez
title: LaMelo Ball trade rumors emerge after NBA Draft; 2 suitors named - NewsBreak
text:
By Victor Galvez ,
18 minutes ago
The NBA offseason is in full swing and several teams are busy engaging in potential trades. The Charlotte Hornets are reportedly listening to calls inquiring about LaMelo Ball. The star guard is fresh off a solid season, leading the franchise to the play-in tournament.
Ball was drafted by Charlotte at No. 3 in 2020. He has dealt with different injuries throughout his career but has produced impressive numbers when healthy. However, the team has not had success, last reaching the playoffs in 2016.
MORE: Lavar Ball announces breakup with wife Tina after nearly 30 years
Shams Charania reported the development on Wednesday. The ESPN senior insider highlighted that Ball wants to remain in Charlotte but the team is receiving aggressive offers.
NBA correspondent Marc Stein posted on X that the Minnesota Timberwolves and Toronto Raptors have emerged as having interest on the one-time All-Star.
Minnesota traded Julius Randle for a second-round pick on Monday, while Toronto is searching for a star to add. Both teams are intriguing landing spots, potentially pairing Ball with Anthony Edwards or Scottie Barnes.
Feb 7, 2026; Atlanta, Georgia, USA; Charlotte Hornets guard LaMelo Ball (1) dribbles against the Atlanta Hawks in the fourth quarter at State Farm Arena. Mandatory Credit: Brett Davis-Imagn Images LaMelo Ball’s 2025-26 season performance Ball appeared in 79 games, including 69 starts last season. He averaged 20.1 points, 4.8 rebounds, 7.1 assists and 1.2 steals. The Hornets secured the No. 9 seed in the Eastern Conference but lost to the Orlando Magic in the second phase.
The 6-foot-7 point guard’s youth and exciting play style could attract more teams to bid for his services. Charania stressed that his situation is a developing story, with a chance to get traded in the next 24-48 hours.
